summary: Gets and sets a user's preferences and language, using the shapes from the types file.
purpose: Lets the app remember each user's sports and language choice.
why: Reason not stated beyond the comments; the language-only save is kept separate.
how: Passes the sports and language to the data layer, then returns the stored values in the shared shape. Loading returns null if the user is not found.
inputs: A user id, plus preferences or a language.
risks: Stored values are cast to the expected types without a check, so a bad stored value passes through unnoticed.
debug: If the wrong language shows, check the stored value and the cast in this file.
